summary: Frontend login/auth flow verified end-to-end on production preview URL. Cleared localStorage, typed patient credentials into data-testid auth-email/auth-password and clicked auth-submit-btn: POST /api/auth/login -> 200 with token+user, localStorage 'mf_token' set (245 chars), redirected to /patient, 'Your requests' heading visible. Demo patient button (demo-patient-btn) also succeeded (200, token set, redirect to /patient). Demo pharmacy button (demo-pharmacy-btn) succeeded (200, token set, redirect to /pharmacy, 'Downtown Rx · Live queue' rendered). GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returned 200 with full pharmacy user object. No console errors, no page errors, no CORS or 4xx issues observed.
action_items: No action needed. The reported 'login not working' bug could NOT be reproduced. All three login paths (typed patient, demo patient button, demo pharmacy button) succeed and redirect correctly. The previous reproduction failure was likely browser autofill in the testing tool as main agent suspected — typing with delay reliably lands correct values into the controlled inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.login stores token in localStorage — OK for this app spec (JWT in body + Authorization Bearer). Note this is XSS-susceptible; consider httpOnly cookies for production hardening (not blocking).
api.js has no response interceptor for 401 to auto-logout / clear token; consider adding to avoid stale-token UX bugs.
AuthPage submit uses form.email.trim().toLowerCase() — good; keep this normalization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow fully working as of this iteration. If user still reports 'login not working', ask for exact browser, whether extensions/autofill are involved, and check localStorage for stale/invalid mf_token that survives across sessions (AuthProvider only clears on /auth/me failure — a malformed token that returns 200 wouldn't be cleared).
rca of the issue: No bug reproduced. Likely originally caused by the screenshot-tool's browser autofill overwriting the email field before submit (as main agent noted). With clean localStorage + typed input, POST /api/auth/login returns 200 and full navigation succeeds for both roles.
